coordinates.q4: absolute Lhip,Lcrank,Rhip,Rcrank joint-output rad; not passive knee

cache: Use exact 3*(base+4plus+4minus) FK values already called inside terms/derivatives for independent elastic U; no extra FK/potential query.
withdraw_counter_compensation: newFF6=originalTrim6+tauGas6; only legs0,1,3,4, preserve wheels2,5 bit-exact
mixed_velocity: Compute slide_rate=Dgas@fixed_qd and elastic/damping/total virtual powers using cached Dgas only. Never call terms with nonzero qd (would exceed FK budget). Do not remove damping in the static FF helper.
failure: Stop at first budget/domain/numerical failure; save prefix once, keep unchanged gates, no new pose/test reruns.
runtime_helper: Read and verify small public/gain sources once at load, return immutable precomputed endpoints; no model import/FK/runtime identification/interpolation. Default disabled, only exact timed_push may use bound endpoint reference/old trim. Other phases unchanged. No actuator/permission.
unknown: Public nominal gas/trim decomposition is not measured spring force, hardware confidence or proof of a uniquely isolated spring term inside old trim. Endpoint-only, not nonlinear intermediate or actual-DR compensation.
